_readme: THE OWNER'S OWN 30th Celebration MASTER SET. This is the only page on the
site that tracks what he personally owns rather than what he has pulled on
camera, and the two are different: data/hits.json is a record of hits that
appeared in a video, and this is a record of cards in a binder however they
got there -- pulled, traded, or bought as a single.
HOW IT GETS FILLED IN. He lists the cards after a 30th video and they get
added here by hand, one object per card. There is no form, no login and no
browser storage anywhere in this feature, and that is deliberate: the site
is static files, so a localStorage tracker would live in one browser on one
device, would be lost the first time he cleared site data, and would be
invisible to search engines and to him on his phone. A committed JSON file
renders into the page at build time, works everywhere, survives a new
laptop, and is in git history.
FIELDS
name     the card, as printed. Required.
n        collector number, when known. OPTIONAL and often absent,
because the English numbering was not published before release;
a card with no number still counts and still draws a pocket.
section  one of: pikachu, main, secret, classic, energy. Required, since
it decides which binder page the card lands on.
got      the date it entered the binder, YYYY-MM-DD.
video    the YouTube id it was opened in, when it was opened on camera.
Absent for a trade, a single, or a card from before the tracker.
note     anything worth saying. Optional.
DUPLICATES ARE NOT RECORDED HERE. A master set is one of each; a second
copy changes nothing on this page. If doubles ever need tracking that is a
different file, not a count on these objects.
THE DENOMINATOR IS NOT OFFICIAL AND THE PAGE SAYS SO. TPCi has never
published a card count for this set -- checked against its product showcase
and both press releases. PokeBeach counts 199 in English and that is the
number the progress bars run against, attributed to them every place it is
shown. It may move when the last secret rares are revealed. See
data/30th.json's readme.
SO 0 OF 199 IS THE CORRECT STARTING STATE, not a bug. The set releases 16
September 2026 and this file was written on the 11th.

owned.name: Hydreigon
owned.note: Read off the card: 099/128, set code 30C, regulation mark J, Stage 2 evolving from Zweilous, 170 HP. NOT in Japan's 176 card list at all, which is the clearest single proof that the English set is a different set and not a translation of it.

owned.name: Igglybuff
owned.note: Read off the card: 120/128, set code 30C, regulation mark J, 30 HP. Japan prints this card too, at #096, so the same card sits at two different numbers in the two sets. That is the numbering mismatch this page keeps warning about, demonstrated on one card.

owned.name: Basic Metal Energy
owned.note: Read off the card: MEE 016, NOT a 30C number, with the rainbow 30th Pikachu stamp and YOSHIROTTEN's name on it, which matches TPCi saying he designed the Energy. So the set's eight foil Energy are numbered in the MEE Energy sheet rather than in the main set.

_shotNote: EVERY `shot` IS THE OWNER'S OWN PHOTOGRAPH of the card in his hand, built by
scripts/build-30th-cards.py from a master in assets-source/30th-cards/.
The value is the master's stem; the builder resolves the renditions.
A card with no `shot` falls back to a TCGdex scan, and if TCGdex has no set
yet it draws as a pocket with no picture. See that script's header for why
photographs rather than scans: on 11 September 2026 no scan of this set
existed in any source this site may use.
